title: iris florentina subsp. albicans
intro: Iris florentina subsp. albicans, commonly known as the Florentine iris or Eleuthero, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the iris family, native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving the immune system, and has been reported to have various therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Iris florentina subsp. albicans include flavonoids, terpenoids, and iridoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties. The plant's health benefits and therapeutic actions make it a valuable resource for natural medicine and herbal remedies.
